evidence.methodDecision: PixelLab search_help는 edit_image 동일편집만지원/per-index 자세 미지원, edit_image_pixen 고정1generation을확인했다. 기존업로드2개를6call에재사용했다.
evidence.qualityAcceptance: 부모 세션이 두 Pro 후보를 검토용으로 선택했다. 사용자 시각 품질 승인과 구분하며 대표 두 방향의 GIF 판단을 기다린다.
evidence.alphaBoundsConvention: right/bottom은 PIL getbbox의 배타적 경계다. PNG 색·알파·native크기는 수정하지 않았다.
evidence.assetVerification: 8개 생성 PNG의 view_image 정적 확인·native64×64·SHA·alphaBounds를 기록했다. 실제 동작 연결/재생과 GIF 품질 검토는 담당 세션에서 수행한다.

request.description: Redraw each supplied Ataho sprite into ONE extreme forced-perspective straight-punch KEY POSE directly INTO THE CAMERA LENS. The closest clenched tiger fist MUST be enormous, 25-30 pixels wide in this 64x64 image and visibly larger than the rear head. This fist fills the lower foreground and overlaps part of the body. Draw a very short broad foreshortened wrist and forearm receding away from the giant fist to a SMALL shoulder, SMALL chest, and SMALL rear head. Strong actual arm anatomy and severe depth, not an ordinary sideways punch, not an outstretched long lateral arm, not merely enlarging the entire character. The torso and legs stay farther back and smaller. Preserve the first input's SOUTH-EAST front/side body and the second input's NORTH-WEST back/side body separately, including the visible back on the second; do not turn both into the same front pose. The near punching arm reaches toward the viewer even while the torso retains its own direction. Preserve Ataho's mature orange tiger face, stripes, ears, tail, brown and ivory sleeveless martial clothes with charcoal accents. Planted feet and solid stance. Crisp original 64x64 pixel-art grid, transparent background, one complete character per frame, no text, no speed effects, no aura, no mirroring or full-sprite rotation. Entire ears, giant fist, feet and tail fit inside 64x64 with at least 1 transparent pixel at canvas edges.
